Name: HxW Restaurant Furniture Set
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[center][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OkEwQOJ.png[/img]

[/size][/font][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]This mod adds 12 table furniture pieces for decorating a restaurant or cafe using Content Patcher, and then adds ANOTHER 14 variations for EACH table using Alternative Textures!  These additional table settings include plates, wine, cheese, desserts, tea and even seasonal options for the spring, summer, fall and winter!

[/size][size=4]Spring variant features Egg Festival decor and Fall features Spirits Eve decor.
Summer variant features  Kailey's Feast of the Sun mod which you can find [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30405]HERE[/url]
Winter variant features Airyn's Solstice Winter Star decor which you can find [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14272]HERE[/url]
[/size][size=3]
This is all new furniture using Content Patcher! You can find the furniture either using something like CJB Item Spawner OR you can
purchase the brand new Restaurant Furniture Catalogue from Robin's Shop!

[/size][size=5][b][u]How to Install:[/u][/b][/size][size=3]

[/size][/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Make sure you have the required mods installed first.
[/size][/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Choose ONE of the wood color options from the files section of this mod. Y[u]ou can't install all of them at once. [/u]If you wish to have multiple wood colors, pick ONE CP version of the mod to use, then choose as many of the AT packs as you'd like to add on. The AT packs can all be added in, but again, only ONE CP version of this mod can be installed.[/size][/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]
[i]Example: I want to play with the Cream Furniture set, so I download that set from the files section of the mod. Later, I decide I'd like to ALSO have the chocolate variant, so I download that set but I ONLY add the AT Chocolate pack into my mods folder.[/i]

[b]We also highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] since it makes using the different textures super easy and allows for search functionality! [/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RHabloO.png[/img]

[/size][/font][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]Thanks to Airyn and Kailey for allowing us to use their assets so we can have compatibility with their mods for Feast of the Sun and Solstice Winter Star! Please check them out at the links above in the about section of the description![/size][size=3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nY2cWBM.png[/img]﻿

[/size][size=5][b]Support Hime on [url=https://www.patreon.com/Himetarts]Patreon[/url]﻿ and follow her on [url=https://twitter.com/himetarts]Twitter[/url] for previews!
[/b]
[b]Buy Wildflour a [url=https://ko-fi.com/wildflourmods]Kofi[/url]﻿ [/b]!

It's absolutely [u]not required ever[/u] to enjoy our mods which will always be free for all; but we thank each and every one of you who has donated or will possibly in the future. <3[/size][/font][/center]
